category.creator: Creator
node.mcp_toolset.desc: Apply a configured MCP endpoint: register its tools and inject its resources
node_err.mcp_endpoint_empty: No MCP endpoint selected. Choose a configured endpoint in this node.
node_err.mcp_no_endpoints: No MCP endpoint is configured. Add one in the MCP Toolset settings page.
node_err.mcp_endpoint_not_found: MCP endpoint '{0}' was not found. Check the identifier in the MCP Toolset settings page.
node_err.mcp_catalog_invalid: MCP endpoint configuration could not be read: {0}
node_err.mcp_connect_failed: Failed to connect to MCP endpoint '{0}': {1}
node_err.mcp_tools_failed: MCP endpoint '{0}' failed to list tools: {1}
node_err.mcp_resources_failed: MCP endpoint '{0}' failed to read resources: {1}
node.api_select.desc: Choose which API configuration to use for generation
node.append_chat_messages.desc: Append live chat messages from the current Chat into context fragments
node.advanced_fragment.desc: Inject a message fragment with images, tool_calls, tool_call_id, thinking and custom properties for complex role payloads
node.special_role_image_carrier.desc: Move images from system / tool / assistant messages into an adjacent pseudo-user message grouped with the original, for compatible endpoints that reject images in those roles
node.call_preset.desc: Load and execute a preset from Generation Manager
node.dyn_prompt.desc: Evaluate DynPrompt trigger rules and inject matching prompts
node.merge_fragments.desc: Merge all context fragments into a single fragment with the selected role
node.message_print_latest.desc: Print the latest fragment's message content to console
node.message_print.desc: Print context fragments as JSON to console
node.message_print_v2.desc: Print context fragments with ANSI role-based coloring to console
node.print.desc: Print a template to console with {time} and {total_len} macro support
node.st_style_macro.desc: Replace {{user}} and {{char}} macros in fragment message contents
node.tool_preset.desc: Load a tool preset from ToolManager
node.file_system_tool_set.desc: Select FileSystem tools to enable and configure file access scope (Override/Union/Intersection with global config)
node.set_value.desc: Write a key/value pair to SharedState (this generation only) or KVData (persisted)
node.config.desc: Easy-adjust settings node: define items (name / SharedState key / type / default) in Edit mode, adjust each item's value in Configure mode; effective values are written into SharedState (this generation only)
node.comment.desc: A multi-line note node with no effect, used only for documentation in the node tree
node.web_search_auto.desc: Searches the web from the input content (or a fixed query) and appends the results to the end of the context
node.web_search_tool_set.desc: Adds the search tool, and the fetch tool when the provider supports it, to this generation
node.codeact.desc: Adds a C# code-execution tool. Scripts can call every tool available in this round, observe cancellation, and put tool images into the result container manually when image output is enabled. Place it anywhere in the pre-generation tree; tools added later in the same round are still callable.
node.markdown_render.desc: Renders message text to HTML with Markdig, with pipe tables and math formulas (KStyleMath) as toggles
node.code_highlight.desc: Adds syntax highlighting to fenced code blocks; must run after the Markdown Render node. Languages listed in the skip list (e.g. SVG / Mermaid) are left untouched for other nodes to render
node.code_block_actions.desc: Adds a language label and Copy / Download buttons to code blocks; must run after the Markdown Render node. The buttons are wired up by a host script
node.svg_render.desc: Renders SVG in code blocks (or XML whose root is SVG) as an image; must run after Markdown Render and before Code Highlight / Code Block Actions. Copy / Download buttons are optional. The SVG is loaded as an image through a data URL, so scripts do not execute
node_err.api_no_continuation: APISelect: Continuation requested but API type '{0}' does not support prefix continuation.
node_err.call_no_presets: CallNode: No generation presets found in KVData.
node_err.call_empty_json: CallNode: Generation preset '{0}' has empty RootNodeJson.
node_err.call_deserialize_failed: CallNode: Failed to deserialize root node from preset '{0}'.
node_err.dynprompt_parse_failed: DynPrompt: Failed to parse DynPromptSets from KVData.
node_err.dynprompt_trigger_eval_failed: DynPrompt: Failed to evaluate trigger rule for term '{0}'.
node_err.subagent_no_tree: SubAgent: No modifier tree configured for '{0}'. Assign a preset or create a private tree.
node_err.tool_instantiate_type_not_found: ToolInstantiate: Type '{0}' not found or does not implement IAutoCreateToolV2.
node_err.tool_instantiate_create_failed: ToolInstantiate: Failed to create instance of '{0}'.
node_err.codeact_duplicate: CodeAct: a CodeAct tool is already present in this generation. Remove the duplicate CodeAct node.
node_err.config_parse_failed: ConfigNode: failed to parse config item data.
node_err.config_empty_key: ConfigNode: item "{0}" is missing a SharedState key.
node.post_tool_call.desc: Executes the tool calls requested in this round and writes the results back into the conversation. Without this node in the post-generation tree, tool calls are never executed.
node_err.dangling_tool_calls: Chat history contains {0} unanswered tool call(s): {1}. Repair the messages or switch this node to InjectPlaceholder.
node.post_loop_directive.desc: Explicitly sets the loop directive for this round. It is applied after the whole tree runs, so placing it last gives it the final say.
node.post_message.desc: Appends a message to the conversation (visible to the next round) or replaces this round's assistant response text.
node.post_condition.desc: Branches on this round's response, tool calls, shared state or KV storage. Use it to express rules like "stop when the tool is X" or "continue when the text contains a marker".
node.post_sub_agent.desc: Process LLM response text using a sub-agent in the post-generation pipeline
node.auto_chat_name.desc: After generation, automatically checks if the chat name is a default date format and uses LLM to generate a meaningful name
node.image_generation_tool_set.desc: Adds enabled image generation configurations (ComfyUI / A1111) to this generation; expose all of them or a single selected configuration
node_err.image_generation_config_invalid: Image generation configuration is invalid. Please review and save it in the Image Generation settings panel.
node_err.image_generation_attachments_un: Image generation requires the image storage service, but it is unavailable in the current session.
node_err.image_generation_model_missing: Configuration '{0}' uses the ComfyUI default workflow but has no checkpoint model. Select a model in Settings → Image Generation, or use another configuration.
node_err.image_generation_duplicate_tool: Two image generation configurations resolve to the same tool name '{0}'. Check the configuration ids in the Image Generation settings.
node_err.image_generation_config_not_fou: The image generation configuration '{0}' selected by this node does not exist. Please choose another configuration.
node_err.image_generation_config_disable: The image generation configuration '{0}' ({1}) selected by this node is disabled. Enable it in the Image Generation settings panel first.
node_err.web_search_config_invalid: Web search configuration is invalid. Please review and save it in the Web Search settings panel.
node_err.web_search_no_user_input: Auto web search: no user message is available in the chat to use as a query.
node_err.web_search_static_query_empty: Auto web search: the query source is 'Fixed text' but the fixed query is empty.
node_err.web_search_no_api: Auto web search: query rewriting is enabled but no API has been selected yet (add an API select node earlier in the pre-generation tree).
node_err.web_search_rewrite_placeholder_: Auto web search: the rewrite prompt must contain the {0} placeholder.
node_err.web_search_rewrite_empty: Auto web search: the model returned an empty query.
node_err.web_search_rewrite_failed: Auto web search: query rewriting failed: {0}
node_err.web_search_api_key_missing: Web search service {0} has no API key. Configure it in the Web Search settings panel.
node_err.web_search_provider_unresolved: Could not resolve a web search service. Check the Web Search settings.
node_err.memory_no_vector_store: The host does not provide a vector store.
node_err.memory_not_ready: Memory index is not ready ({0}). Build or verify it in Settings first.
